lines: Lyrics: Kenshi Yonezu

If only this were a dream, how wonderful that would be
How great it would be if everything were just a dream
Even now I still see you in my dreams
Even now I still dream of you
Like returning to fetch something I forgot
Like going back to retrieve a lost item
Dusting off the cobwebs of old memories
Brushing away the dust on ancient recollections
There are joys that will never return
There are happinesses that can never come back
The last thing you taught me
The final lesson you gave me
Even the dark past I kept hidden, unable to speak
The bleak history I concealed, unable to utter
Without you, eternity would remain forever dark
If you were gone, it would stay eternally dim
Surely there will be no more wounds to bear
There will be nothing else to hurt me
I understand that such pain will not arise
I know I cannot be hurt any further
Even the sorrow of that day
Even the grief of that day
Even the anguish of that day
Even the pain of that day
I loved all of it, together with you
I loved everything, as long as you were by my side
It lingers in my chest, refusing to leave
It remains in my heart, unshakable
The scent of bitter lemon
The aroma of sour lemon
I cannot go home until the rain stops
I won’t return until the rain ceases
Even now, you are still my light
Even today, you remain my light
In the darkness I traced the outline of your back
In the night I followed the curve of your spine
I remember that silhouette with crystal clarity
I recall every contour vividly
Each time I meet something I cannot grasp
Whenever I confront the uncontainable
Only tears overflow endlessly
The only thing that keeps pouring is my tears
What were you doing then?
What were you doing?
What were you looking at?
What did you see?
With a profile I never knew
With a side view I had never seen
Somewhere, now, you
If somewhere you are now
Just as I am
Just like me
If you are lost in tears, within loneliness
Drowning in tears, amid solitude
Please, forget about me
I beg you, forget me
I wish that from the bottom of my heart
I earnestly hope for that
Even now, you are still my light
Even today, you remain my light
You, who loved more than you thought you did
You, who fell deeper in love than I ever imagined
Since then I cannot breathe as I used to
Since that day, I cannot draw a normal breath
We were so close, yet it feels like a lie
Though we were near, it now seems like a falsehood
I cannot forget; that alone is certain
Only that is sure: I cannot forget
Even the sorrow of that day
Even the grief of that day
Even the anguish of that day
Even the pain of that day
I loved everything, together with you
I loved it all, as long as you were with me
It stays in my chest, never leaving
It remains lodged in my heart
The scent of bitter lemon
The smell of sour lemon
I cannot go home until the rain stops
I won’t return until the rain ceases
Like one half of a split fruit
Like a half of a fruit that has been divided
